title: Early Bird Takes a Dive with Latest Hit "Swim"
htmlContent:
Buffalo-born rapper Early Bird has just released his latest single, "Swim," making waves in the music scene. With a smooth and catchy hook, this pop and mainstream rap fusion is the perfect party anthem to have you dancing and singing.

Early Bird has made a name for himself in the music industry since shifting from metal to rap in 2016. He draws influences from various genres, including hip-hop, rap, R&B, and metal, creating a unique sound that sets him apart from other artists.

"Swim" is a fun and upbeat song that showcases Early Bird's talent and versatility as an artist. The track talks about living life to the fullest and taking risks, making it an empowering and uplifting tune that makes you feel good.

If you're looking for a new artist to add to your playlist, look no further than Early Bird. With his debut EP "I Am" and a mixtape set to drop in the Spring of 2023, he's an artist to watch.
